title: The guard refuses a git merge, commit or push joined by ";" after a git switch or checkout
why: Lane comment-check-scans-shell (session_013NEJL37UFXTQuAcox7s8fD), 10:03 CST Nov 8: `git switch X; ...; git merge origin/main` ran the merge on the branch the tree already held (#2050), because the switch failed when another worktree held X. Aborted before a commit.
note: Filed 10:29 CST Nov 8 from that lane. Fix: refuse the chained form; the remedy says join with && or split the calls. Related, not the same: push-after-check-semicolon (a push after a check), one-worktree-per-branch.
